title: Code input
summary: A one-time code -- from a message, an authenticator, an email -- as a form field with its own value, paste and errors, drawn as the class verification: one native input holds the code (autocomplete one-time-code, so autofill and WebOTP fill it whole) and the cells picture it. Typing fills the next cell, Backspace steps back and clears, a pasted code fills every cell, and each cell is announced by its place.

template.description: Template variant name for SfBaseElement external templates.

root-class.description: Classes added to the root element the component draws.

root-style.description: Inline style declarations set on the root element the component draws, custom properties included.

length.description: How many characters the code has, 1 to 12; one cell each.

default-value.description: The code a form reset returns to; the field starts with it when there is no value.

name.description: The form name of the native input, which is the form value.

mode.description: numeric: digits, a digit keyboard; alphanumeric: Latin letters and digits. A charset takes its place. Anything else typed or pasted is left out. The inner input carries no pattern: a code that is not whole is too-short on the host, in the page's words.

charset.description: An own alphabet (owner C82): only these characters are kept, each written once, for example 23456789BCDFGHJKMNPQRTVWXY (Steam Guard, without 0 O 1 I). Set, it takes the place of mode; the keyboard is a digit one when the alphabet holds digits only, and a cell is spoken as a digit then.

uppercase.description: Letters typed or pasted become capitals before the characters are kept (owner C82): a pasted ab12cd is AB12CD, and the keyboard offers capitals (autocapitalize characters). With an upper-case charset set it too, so a lower-case letter is taken.

groups.description: Cells per group, with a separator drawn between the groups (owner C82): 3 for 3 + 3, 4 for 4 + 4; 2 to 6 and shorter than the code. 0 (the default) draws none. The separator is a picture only: never in the value, a copy, a paste or what a screen reader reads.

size.description: A step of the form-field ladder, as sf-input's: the cells and their text.

appearance.description: bordered: cells divided by a border; filled: cells on a tonal fill, which become bordered while the code has focus.

label.description: The visible label; it names the group and the field.

hint.description: Text under the cells: how many characters, where the code comes from.

required.description: The form asks for a whole code.

invalid.description: The code was refused: cells and hint in the error colour, aria-invalid on the field. The host sets and clears it.

error-message.description: Shown in place of the hint while invalid, and the field's aria-errormessage.

mask.description: Each character shows as a dot; the field is a password field, so a screen reader does not read the code out.

value.description: The code. Written as an attribute it is controlled: the attribute follows what the person types. Kept to the mode and the length.

aria-label.description: The name of the group and the field when there is no visible label.

error.description: Legacy name for invalid, still honoured.

getInputElement.summary: Returns the inner native input, or null before render.

input.summary: The code changed while typing, pasting or by autofill; the native event bubbles from the inner input, which is its target, with the value already kept to the mode and the length. It carries no detail.

payload.description: A native Event: there is no detail.

change.summary: The code was committed: the field lost focus with a code other than the one it had when it took focus. Sent once from the inner input. It carries no detail.

payload.description: A native Event: there is no detail.

sf-input-code-completed.summary: The fact completed (standard 1.3.8 §8): every cell holds a character, after an edit the person made; once for each whole code, after its input event. The element never submits the form.

sf-code-input:complete.summary: Legacy name of sf-code-input-completed, sent after it with the same detail until 2026-12-01 (aliases.json, standard 1.3.8 §16.20).

accessibility.focus: The group (role group) and the one native input are named by the label, or by aria-label without one. The input is described by a polite line that says the caret's cell -- «цифра 3 из 6», «digit 3 of 6», «символ» or «character» for an alphanumeric code -- in the page's language, said again each time the caret changes cell; then by the hint or the error message. Typing fills the caret's cell and moves on, Backspace clears the cell before the caret and steps back, the arrows, Home and End move between the cells, a click puts the caret in the cell clicked. The cells and the group separators are aria-hidden; a selection is painted on the cells, and a copy gives the selected code (never a masked one); the characters run left to right in a right-to-left page too.

ai_guidance.use_when: Use sf-input-code for a one-time code a person types or pastes -- from a text message, an authenticator app, an email -- as a field of a native form.
do_not: Do not copy generated ui-smart code
Do not use it for a PIN or password the person chooses: that is sf-input with input-type password
Do not submit the form or check the code from the complete event alone: the host checks it
Do not restyle its cells: they are the class verification's, set its public variables
ai_guidance.minimal_example: <sf-input-code label="Код из сообщения" name="code" hint="Мы отправили шесть цифр на +7 900 000-00-00"></sf-input-code>
